messages:
Diego: Heads-up: partner meter in Brazil showing hourly window drift after last weekendDST patch. Some hourly batches overlap and could double-count.
Hannah: Which partner id? Impact estimate?
Diego: partner_id=217, affected window 2026-10-03T01:00:00-03:00 to 2026-10-03T03:00:00-03:00. Preliminary: ~720 overlapping rows across 27 customers.
Jules: Likely timezone/timestamp rounding on edge aggregator. We recently changed to store event_ts as epoch seconds instead of iso strings.
BillingBot: Alert: 720 overlapping device-hour events detected. Potential overcharge exposure ~BRL 1,420.
Hannah: Can you paste the quick query you used to detect overlaps?
Diego: Query I ran:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, event_hour, count(*) as cnt
FROM marketplace_usage
WHERE partner_id = 217
  AND event_hour BETWEEN '2026-10-03T01:00:00-03:00' AND '2026-10-03T04:00:00-03:00'
GROUP BY customer_id, event_hour
HAVING cnt > 1;
```
Jules: Root cause: aggregator emitted both local_hour and utc_hour records when DST flag was present; downstream merge logic didn't dedupe on fingerprint.
InfraOps: Short-term: enable hourly dedupe by fingerprint for partner 217 and provision a backfill worker. Will take ~45m.
Hannah: Reserve customers? Any in the 27?
Diego: Three reserved customers. We'll exclude them from auto-credit flow.
Jules: Hotfix: PR to marketplace-aggregator to prefer utc_hour and add fingerprint md5(payload) fallback. Pushed to review: https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-aggregator/pull/712
BillingBot: Recommended steps:
1) Snapshot overlapping rows and attach CSV to partner record
2) Enable fingerprint dedupe for partner 217
3) Run backfill collapse keeping earliest posted_ts
4) Issue credits for non-reserved customers where billed > collapsed_usage
5) Monitor for 24h
Diego: I'll run step 1 and share CSV.
InfraOps: Fingerprint dedupe enabled at 2026-10-03T02:10:00-03:00. Worker pool scaled +1.
Hannah: Notifying partner with summary and asking them to pause any replay jobs until we confirm.
Jules: After hotfix merged, we'll add an alert if overlap rate > 0.5% in 15m window.
BillingBot: Closed loop: 682 rows collapsed, 38 legitimate distinct events, credit estimate BRL 1,360 issued for non-reserved customers.
Diego: Attaching CSV to partner record and closing after ledger job finishes. Thanks team.
